quote: The invisible hand of the internet, bidding in the dark.
definition: A digital marketplace that connects DSPs and SSPs through real-time auctions. It handles the auction mechanics, fraud filtering, and clearing of billions of ad transactions per day — all in under 100ms.

quote: The team that turns financial complexity into business clarity. And approves your budget.
definition: To transform financial complexity into business clarity, building trusted partnerships externally and internally SO THAT together we can scale faster with precision and certainty

quote: We'll pay you when the sale happens. Don't hold your breath.
definition: A performance-based channel where third-party publishers promote a brand's products in exchange for a commission on each resulting sale or lead. Particularly effective for e-commerce.

quote: The technology rewriting every job description. Including yours.
definition: The capability of computational systems to perform tasks associated with human intelligence — learning, reasoning, decision-making. In programmatic, AI powers bid optimisation algorithms, audience modelling, creative personalisation, and fraud detection.

quote: The thing the developer says you need before you know what you need.
definition: A set of protocols allowing different software systems to communicate and exchange data. In ad tech, APIs connect DSPs with DMPs, dashboards with reporting tools, and creative platforms with ad servers. The invisible plumbing of the entire programmatic stack.

quote: The department that makes the world aware Tangoo exists. And want to work with us.
definition: Tangoo's commercial growth engine — transforming market signals into measurable momentum through strategic storytelling and data-driven frameworks. Attracts high-potential customers through knowledge, reputation, and engineered connections.

quote: The only ad format that follows you into the shower.
definition: Automated buying and selling of audio ad inventory across streaming music platforms, podcasts, and digital radio. Reaches listeners in screen-free environments — commuting, exercising, cooking — with no option to scroll past.

quote: The world's largest affiliate network. Someone has to manage the chaos.
definition: A global affiliate and partner marketing platform connecting over 25,000 advertisers with 1 million+ publishers worldwide. Provides the technology infrastructure for tracking, reporting, and paying affiliate commissions.

quote: Selling to companies instead of people. The lunch is excellent.
definition: A commercial model where a company sells to other businesses rather than consumers. In programmatic, B2B campaigns target professional audiences via LinkedIn and trade publications — with longer consideration cycles but significantly higher deal values.

quote: The team that makes sure the internal engine runs as well as the external one.
definition: A specialist team within Tangoo's Elevate Department focused on business efficiency and process improvement — identifying operational bottlenecks, designing better workflows, and ensuring company systems are scalable.

quote: The tool that places your bids. Whether you understand them or not.
definition: TBD

quote: The team behind the tools behind the work.
definition: The Elevate team responsible for managing and optimising the internal technology platforms Tangoo uses to operate — from CRM and project management to financial systems. Ensures every team has the right tools, configured correctly.

quote: The reason people pay more for the logo. Apparently.
definition: The commercial value derived from consumer perception of a brand beyond functional product value. Strong brand equity drives premium pricing, loyalty, and resilience during market disruption. Brand awareness programmatic campaigns are the primary lever for building it at scale.

quote: Project management software. Because spreadsheets were too honest about deadlines.
definition: A cloud-based productivity platform centralising tasks, documents, goals, and communication into a single workspace. Used at Tangoo to manage cross-team workflows, campaign processes, and strategic initiatives.

quote: Attract opens the door. Convert walks through it.
definition: The purpose of departement is  - To develop strategic partnerships with brands, agencies and networks SO THAT we can grow Tangoo's client portofolio, revenue, and international presence and strenghten Tangoo's position as a multichannel programmatic partner

quote: We don't pay for views. We pay for results. Allegedly.
definition: A performance pricing model where the advertiser only pays when a specific action is completed (a purchase, a sign-up, a download). The holy grail of performance marketing: you only pay when it works.

quote: You paid how much to get someone to download that app?
definition: The cost to acquire one app installation through paid advertising, calculated as total spend divided by installs. The primary KPI for mobile user acquisition campaigns. Varies widely by vertical — gaming installs cost far less than fintech ones.

quote: A thousand eyeballs for the price of one coffee. Maybe.
definition: The cost an advertiser pays for one thousand ad impressions, regardless of whether anyone clicks. The standard pricing model for brand awareness campaigns in display and video advertising.

quote: How much does it cost to make someone buy? More than yesterday.
definition: The total advertising cost divided by the number of orders generated. Similar to CPA but specific to e-commerce transactions, making it the go-to KPI for online retail campaigns.

quote: The team that makes people stop scrolling. For about 1.3 seconds.
definition: The purpose of departement is  - To build and cultivate a technically brilliant and data-centric visual assets development engine through relentless experimentation and the predicitve engineering of human attention, expectations and surprise, SO THAT we empower internal teams to achieve their full potential, from converting to delivering and delighting, and provide our clients with unmateched creative impact across every modern display advertising channel.

quote: All your customer data in one place. Theoretically.
definition: A system for managing a company's interactions with existing and potential customers. As third-party cookies deprecate, first-party CRM data is becoming one of the most valuable targeting assets in programmatic.

quote: Not support. Not sales. The person between both who keeps everything from falling apart.
definition: The role dedicated to proactively ensuring clients achieve their desired outcomes. At Tangoo's Delight Department, CSMs build long-term partnerships, manage escalations, and identify growth opportunities — turning satisfied clients into proud advocates.

quote: Buy Now. Two words. The copywriter's entire career.
definition: The instruction in an ad or landing page prompting a specific user response — Buy Now, Sign Up, Learn More, Download. The final conversion mechanism between exposure and action. Every word, colour, size, and placement has been A/B tested to death.

quote: The living room is now a programmatic channel. Sorry, cable.
definition: Programmatic advertising delivered to internet-connected television screens — Smart TVs, streaming sticks, and set-top boxes. Combines TV's reach and brand impact with digital targeting and measurability.

quote: Someone already picked the best inventory. You just have to afford it.
definition: A private programmatic environment where a specialist curation company pre-selects premium publisher inventory, layers it with proprietary audience data, and packages it for DSP buyers. Combines the scale of programmatic with the quality controls of direct buying.

quote: One brief, a thousand versions. The designer's nightmare, the algorithm's dream.
definition: Technology that automatically generates and serves personalised ad creatives by assembling different elements (headline, image, CTA, offer) based on real-time signals such as audience segment, location, or time of day.

quote: The science of choosing which ad to show, to whom, for how much, right now.
definition: The real-time logic within ad servers and DSPs that determines which creative to serve to which user at any given moment. Advanced decisioning incorporates audience data, frequency capping, sequential messaging rules, and predictive models.

quote: The campaign is live. Now the real work begins.
definition: The purpose of departement is - To build trusful and growth - centric partnerships by providing expert guidance that proactively drives client success SO THAT we turn our partners into proud advocates who are confident to scale with Tangoo, as we spread a customer-centric across our company

quote: Where strategy meets execution. And execution meets the DSP.
definition: Tangoo's operational core — executing programmatic campaigns, developing creative assets, building proprietary technology, and driving measurement innovation. Encompasses Media, Creative, Tech, and Measurement teams.

quote: Five teams. One company. One very contested shared kitchen.
definition: An aggregation of Tangoo teams working toward a shared business function. The five departments are Attract, Convert, Deliver, Delight, and Elevate — each with a defined purpose, sub-teams, and a roadmap aligned to company strategy.

quote: Attract's engine room. Feeds the funnel so Convert has something to work with.
definition: The specialist team within Tangoo's Attract Department responsible for digital demand generation — managing paid media, SEO, content marketing, and inbound lead generation to build brand awareness and fill the commercial pipeline.

quote: No auction. No algorithm. Just you and their inbox.
definition: A marketing approach delivering targeted messages directly to individuals via email, direct mail, SMS, or push notifications. Complements programmatic by retaining existing customers and reactivating lapsed ones without relying on third-party ad inventory.

quote: Banners. The cockroaches of the internet. Always there, rarely clicked.
definition: The oldest and most widespread programmatic channel: visual ads served across websites and apps via DSPs. The foundation of programmatic inventory and the starting point for most campaigns.

quote: Where audiences go to become segments. And segments go to be targeted.
definition: A centralised platform for collecting, organising, and activating first-, second-, and third-party audience data. DMPs feed DSPs with audience segments that make programmatic targeting more precise — though increasingly being replaced by CDPs as cookies deprecate.

quote: A billboard that knows what time it is and who's walking past.
definition: Out-of-home advertising served on digital screens (billboards, transport hubs, retail venues) that can be bought programmatically, enabling dynamic creative, dayparting, and audience-triggered campaigns in the physical world.

quote: We don't buy sites. We buy audiences.
definition: A platform that allows advertisers to automatically purchase ad inventory across multiple exchanges through real-time bidding (RTB) auctions, applying targeting and bid strategies at scale.

quote: Google's DSP. You've heard of Google, right?
definition: Google's enterprise-level demand-side platform, part of the Google Marketing Platform. Provides access to premium inventory, advanced audience data, and deep integration with the Google ecosystem for large-scale programmatic campaigns.

quote: Same budget. Different video for every viewer. Automatically.
definition: Technology that dynamically assembles and personalises video ad content in real time based on audience signals or data triggers. Enables advertisers to serve tailored video messages at scale without producing individual edits for every segment.

quote: CPM's smarter sibling who actually accounts for performance.
definition: The actual revenue or cost per thousand impressions once performance metrics are factored in. Calculated as (Total Earnings ÷ Total Impressions) × 1000. Publishers use it to compare the true value of different ad formats and deal types.

quote: The internal infrastructure team. Without them, nothing else works.
definition: The purpose of Elevate is - To continuously design, implement and optimise the internal engine of Tangoo to bring the best out of our people, our processes and our platforms SO THAT cillactively we are fully enabled to achieve ambitious and sustainable success

quote: Not a review of what happened. Guidance for what's coming.
definition: A forward-looking communication practice where participants share anticipatory observations to help someone prepare for an upcoming challenge — rather than reviewing past performance. At Tangoo, Feedforward reflects a growth mindset culture: less autopsy, more acceleration.

quote: So ubiquitous it's just called 'search.' You know the one.
definition: Google's advertising platform covering paid search, display (via GDN), YouTube video, and app campaigns. The dominant global paid media channel with unmatched reach and intent-based targeting. Usually the first platform any digital advertiser ever touches.

quote: CRM, marketing automation, and email sequences in one. Mostly used for the email sequences.
definition: An all-in-one inbound marketing, CRM, and sales platform. In Tangoo's Attract Department, HubSpot manages lead nurturing, commercial outreach workflows, pipeline visibility, and marketing-to-sales handoffs.

quote: The trade body that sets the rules. And the rules everyone bends.
definition: The global industry organisation developing technical standards, research, and best practices for digital advertising. IAB standards govern ad formats (VAST, MRAID), viewability measurement, and supply chain transparency (ads.txt, sellers.json).

quote: The client you wish you had more of. Turns out you can target them programmatically.
definition: A detailed description of the company or individual that would derive the most value from your product. In programmatic, the ICP informs audience targeting parameters — firmographics for B2B, demographics and behaviours for B2C.

quote: The metric everyone agrees on during briefing, then disagrees on after.
definition: A measurable value used to evaluate campaign success against defined objectives. In programmatic, KPIs range from CTR and viewability for awareness campaigns to CPA and ROAS for performance-driven ones.

quote: Performance. Product. People. Everything at Tangoo lives in one of these three.
definition: The foundational categories > Performance, Product, and People > used to structure the company's work and roadmaps.

quote: We promised 50 qualified leads. We delivered 50 email addresses. Close enough.
definition: The process of attracting and capturing potential customer contact information to nurture toward a purchase. In programmatic, lead gen campaigns drive users to landing pages and forms, with cost-per-lead as the primary success metric.

quote: LinkedIn with superpowers and a monthly cost that requires justification.
definition: LinkedIn's advanced B2B sales intelligence tool offering enhanced prospecting filters, real-time lead recommendations, and CRM integration. Used to identify, research, and engage decision-makers at target accounts with precision.

quote: The metric that makes acquisition costs seem reasonable. Almost.
definition: The total revenue a business can expect from a single customer over the entire relationship. In programmatic, LTV-based bidding strategies allow advertisers to spend more on acquiring customers predicted to generate higher long-term value.

quote: The team that makes Tangoo visible in the rooms where decisions get made.
definition: The Attract team managing Tangoo's presence at industry events and trade fairs, alongside earned media and PR activities. Builds market positioning and brand authority through strategic visibility in the ad tech ecosystem.

quote: Cold to warm. Warm to meeting. Meeting to pipeline.
definition: The Attract team responsible for proactive commercial outreach — crafting and executing targeted communications to reach potential clients. Bridges the gap between brand awareness and the first commercial conversation.

quote: Where client briefs become live campaigns and results become client trust.
definition: The departmet purpose - To design, implement, and constantly evolve Tangoo's speacialist media expertise, SO THAT programmatic media strategy, execution and measurement consistently translate into reliable and scable growth, strong performance, and long-term value for Clients, Partners and the Company

quote: The algorithm learned from your data. Now it outperforms your intuition.
definition: A subset of AI that trains statistical models on historical data to identify patterns and make predictions without explicit programming. In ad tech, ML drives DSP bidding models, lookalike audience expansion, and conversion probability scoring.

quote: You built the audience. Now figure out what to charge for it.
definition: The strategy of generating revenue from an existing asset — website traffic, app users, content, or data. For publishers it means maximising ad inventory revenue via SSPs. For advertisers, it means converting campaign investment into measurable returns.

quote: Every touchpoint thinks it closed the deal. MTA is the referee.
definition: An attribution methodology that assigns credit to multiple ad interactions across the customer journey — not just the last click. Models range from linear and time decay to sophisticated data-driven approaches.

quote: It ships Friday. 'Minimum viable' is doing a lot of work in that sentence.
definition: The simplest version of a product that can be released to gather real user feedback and validate core assumptions with minimal resources. The MVP principle prevents over-engineering and accelerates iteration — build just enough to learn, then improve.

quote: Tangoo's own. Built here. Optimised here. Understood here.
definition: TBD

quote: It doesn't look like an ad. That's the entire point.
definition: Ad formats designed to blend seamlessly with the editorial style of the platform — in-feed articles, sponsored content, recommendation widgets. Typically outperform standard display in engagement but require more creative effort.

quote: How likely are you to recommend us? Scale of 0-10. No pressure.
definition: A customer loyalty metric: Promoters (9-10) minus Detractors (0-6) equals NPS, ranging from -100 to +100. Simple to measure, brutally honest to interpret, and surprisingly difficult to sustain above 50.

quote: Finally, an ad format you can't install an ad blocker for.
definition: Traditional outdoor advertising — billboards, transit posters, street furniture — now increasingly bought programmatically through DOOH inventory. Reaches audiences in the physical world when digital screens can't.

quote: Everyone's invited. The highest bidder wins. May the budget be with you.
definition: The default programmatic buying model where any DSP can bid on any available impression in real time. Maximum reach, maximum competition, and typically lower CPMs than reserved or private deal environments.

quote: The cookie is dead. Long live the identifier.
definition: An industry framework creating privacy-safe, interoperable user identity solutions that function without third-party cookies. Solutions like UID2.0 use hashed and encrypted identifiers to enable audience targeting and measurement in a post-cookie ecosystem.

quote: Direct access to publisher inventory. No middlemen. Fewer mysteries.
definition: A programmatic framework enabling DSPs to connect directly with publisher supply, reducing intermediary hops. Improves transparency, bid density, and cost efficiency for buyers while ensuring publishers capture more of the advertiser's spend.

quote: The result that tells the story, whether we like it or not.
definition: The measurable result or change in business performance that follows as a consequence of specific strategies or internal actions. These outcomes represent the achieved end state of a business direction—such as increased revenue, improved customer retention, or reduced operating costs—and serve as the foundational "why" behind organizational initiatives.

quote: Not Q1. We're Tangoo. We do things our way.
definition: Tangoo's internal planning calendar divides the year into three business Periods rather than standard quarters. Period 1 opens the annual roadmap cycle with fresh strategic priorities, reviewed against the Picture of Success defined at year start.

quote: The middle child of the business year. Underrated. Crucial.
definition: The second of Tangoo's three planning Periods. Mid-year check-in against strategic goals, recalibration of roadmaps, and the point where the year's ambitions meet the reality of what's actually achievable.

quote: Finish strong. Or at least finish.
definition: The final planning Period of the Tangoo business year. Sprint to year-end targets, retrospective review of all three Periods, and the starting point for the next year's strategic planning cycle.

quote: I'll save you the good seat, but I can't promise you'll get it.
definition: A one-to-one agreement giving a buyer first right of refusal on specific inventory at a fixed CPM — without a guaranteed volume commitment. The middle ground between open auction and programmatic guaranteed.

quote: Everything about who we are, how we grow, and how we work together.
definition: The Tangoo Layer encompassing all human workforce initiatives — recruitment, development, wellbeing, culture, and capability building. Without the right people, no amount of product or performance investment matters.

quote: The results we aim for. The ones we can influence but never fully control.
definition: The Tangoo Layer covering quantitative outcomes — revenue, client retention, NPS, campaign KPIs. Performance metrics are the indirect consequence of Product and People work: teams cannot mandate them, but the right inputs make them inevitable.

quote: A unit of time for planning, because standard quarters are too mainstream.
definition: One of the three distinct four-month business cycles at Tangoo used for strategic planning, roadmap calibration, and performance review. Each period serves as a milestone to align team efforts with the company's annual goals and Picture of Success.

quote: The comfort of a direct buy, with a programmatic invoice.
definition: A deal type where advertiser and publisher agree upfront on a fixed volume of impressions at a fixed price — guaranteed. Combines the targeting precision of programmatic with the certainty of a traditional reservation buy.

quote: We planned for everything. Except what actually happened.
definition: Defines the strategic approach to media buying: channels, budgets, audiences, and KPIs. Translates campaign objectives into a structured media plan that the Trader then executes programmatically.

quote: Like an open auction, but with a velvet rope and an invite list.
definition: An invitation-only programmatic auction where a publisher offers premium inventory to a select group of advertisers before it goes to the open market. Better brand safety and higher quality than open auction, at a premium price.

quote: Before the campaign starts, the number exists. After it ends, only the number remains.
definition: The administrative pairing of a Purchase Order (authorising financial commitment) and a Campaign ID (the technical identifier inside the DSP or ad server). Every programmatic campaign requires both before a single impression is bought.

quote: The person everyone emails when they're not sure who to email.
definition: The designated individual responsible for managing communication between two parties — client and agency, team and supplier. Having a clear POC eliminates duplication, speeds up decisions, and ensures accountability on both sides.

quote: The outcome we want to achieve togheter!
definition: A strategic alignment tool used at Tangoo to define what success looks, feels, and functions like for a given initiative before work begins. The PoS creates shared clarity by making the desired end state concrete and specific — preventing teams from building the wrong thing brilliantly.

quote: We don't buy this coverage. We earn it. Slowly.
definition: The practice of managing communications between a brand and its public to build credibility and reputation. PR owns the conversation in moments advertising cannot — crises, cultural relevance, and brand-defining launches.

quote: The best seats in the house. Available. For a price.
definition: High-quality ad inventory sold at above-market CPMs — directly from premium publishers, through PMPs, or programmatic guaranteed deals. Offers better viewability, stronger brand safety, and higher engagement than open auction.

quote: The behaviours we hold ourselves to. Even on bad Mondays.
definition: The core behavioural standards and values that guide how Tangoo operates — defining what is and isn't acceptable, how teams treat each other and clients, and the professional standards expected at every level of the organisation.

quote: Everything we build, do, and deliver. The 'what' behind the results.
definition: The Tangoo Layer representing all initiatives, projects, and standardised actions that teams directly control. Product is the only Layer teams can fully own and directly influence — where strategy becomes execution and ambition becomes deliverables.

quote: Buying ads without picking up the phone. Revolutionary, apparently.
definition: The automated buying and selling of digital advertising inventory using technology, data, and algorithms — replacing manual insertion orders with real-time auctions and data-driven targeting at scale.

quote: The team that makes sure Tangoo's people can do their best work. Including the paperwork.
definition: The Elevate team managing human resources, people operations, and employee experience at Tangoo — covering hiring, onboarding, learning and development, performance frameworks, and cultural programmes.

quote: The 'why' behind everything. Including this glossary.
definition: Tangoo's foundational reason for existing beyond commercial objectives — the deeper mission that guides strategic decisions, shapes culture, and attracts people who want to build something meaningful. The compass against which every significant decision is measured.

quote: A plan. Comprehensive. Ambitious. Updated weekly.
definition: A strategic document outlining goals, initiatives, and timelines over a defined planning horizon. At Tangoo, Roadmaps are structured around the Performance, Product, and People Layers and reviewed each Period. A living document — not a promise.

quote: Divide revenue by spend. Try not to cry.
definition: The revenue generated for every euro spent on advertising. A ROAS of 4x means €4 earned for every €1 spent. The most direct measure of campaign profitability; and the number every client asks about first.

quote: Divide net profit by total cost. Try not to check it too often.
definition: The ratio between net profit and total investment — the fundamental measure of financial efficiency. Underpins every budget decision, post-campaign report, and client renewal conversation. Deceptively simple to calculate, surprisingly difficult to improve.

quote: Milliseconds. That's all we get. Use them wisely.
definition: The automated auction process in which ad impressions are bought and sold in the time it takes a webpage to load, typically under 100 milliseconds. Every page view triggers a bidding war between advertisers competing for the right to show their ad.

quote: That shoe you looked at once will follow you to your grave.
definition: A targeting strategy that re-engages users who have previously visited a website or interacted with a brand. Uses cookies or pixels to identify past visitors and serve them relevant ads across the open web.

quote: Enterprise software that runs the world. Including the invoice pending since March.
definition: A leading enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform managing financial, procurement, HR, and operational processes at scale. At Tangoo, SAP supports internal financial operations via the AFC team.

quote: The only channel where people are actively looking for you. Don't blow it.
definition: Paid advertising on search engine results pages triggered by user queries, primarily via Google Ads. Unlike programmatic display which creates demand, SEA captures it — reaching users at the precise moment of intent.

quote: In writing. Signed. Witnessed. And somehow still contested.
definition: A formal contract defining expected service levels — response times, deliverables, and performance thresholds. In agency life, the SLA is the document everyone quotes when something goes wrong and no one reads when it doesn't.

quote: Because not every road to the publisher is equally honest.
definition: The practice of identifying the most direct, transparent, and cost-efficient routes to publisher inventory. By cutting out unnecessary intermediaries, SPO reduces fee leakage and improves the quality of impressions bought.

quote: Every impression is an auction waiting to happen.
definition: A platform used by publishers to manage and sell their ad inventory programmatically. It connects to multiple DSPs simultaneously, running auctions to maximise revenue on each available impression.

quote: Some clients change campaigns. This one changes lives.
definition: An international humanitarian NGO fighting for children's rights and dignity worldwide, operating in over 40 countries. As a Tangoo partner, TDH represents programmatic expertise put to work for causes that matter — connecting mission-driven organisations with the audiences that can amplify their impact.

quote: The smallest unit of Tangoo with a shared purpose and a separate group chat.
definition: A specific functional unit within a Tangoo Department. Each team operates with its own defined purpose contributing to the broader departmental mission. Example: the Creative Team sits within the Deliver Department.

quote: They built the tools. They maintain the tools. Be kind to them.
definition: The specialist engineering team within Tangoo's Deliver Department — building and maintaining Tangoo's proprietary infrastructure, automated optimisation tools, ML models, and technical integrations.

quote: Fast, cheap, or good. You know the rest.
definition: A decision where optimising for one variable means accepting a worse outcome in another. In media planning: reach vs. precision, brand safety vs. scale, CPM efficiency vs. inventory quality. Recognising trade-offs is the mark of strategic thinking.

quote: Give me a DSP and a deadline, I'll figure out the rest.
definition: The specialist responsible for executing and optimising programmatic campaigns. Manages bid strategies, audience segments, and real-time performance across DSP platforms to meet campaign KPIs.

quote: UI is what it looks like. UX is how it feels. Both matter when the client opens the report.
definition: UI is the visual and interactive design of a digital product. UX is the holistic quality of using it. In ad tech, strong UI/UX in dashboards and campaign tools directly impacts how efficiently teams operate every day.

quote: It's on the invoice. No, the other invoice. Yes, that one.
definition: A consumption tax applied at each stage of production and distribution. In media buying, VAT affects how agency fees, media costs, and supplier invoices are structured — particularly in cross-border EU campaigns where rates vary by country.

quote: A presentation you can't leave without feeling guilty.
definition: An online seminar conducted live via video conferencing. A staple of B2B demand generation for thought leadership, product demos, and lead capture. Programmatic advertising drives registrations at scale, and attendance data is a powerful retargeting signal.

quote: The meeting that could have been an email, now from your kitchen.
definition: A working arrangement where employees work from home rather than a central office. Normalised post-pandemic, WFH reshaped digital team collaboration, accelerated tool adoption, and permanently blurred the boundary between work and everything else.

quote: The roadmap for your budget, before the first impression is bought.
definition: An open standard built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that enables AI agents to discover inventory, negotiate terms, and execute campaigns through a common language. It standardizes agentic workflows across the advertising ecosystem, bridging the gap between strategic intent and automated execution.
